ARCHITECTURE.summary: Post-execution, non-authoritative observation derived from existing context/result/runtime events. Telemetry is never read by prompt construction, routing, authority, result validation or ingest.
ARCHITECTURE.prompt_measurement: build_role_prompt exposes the pre-existing prompt expression byte-for-byte; telemetry stores bytes and methods, not a duplicate prompt.
ARCHITECTURE.failure_firewall: Optional observation failure emits TELEMETRY_FAILED and cannot alter a valid execution result. Direct telemetry identity/correlation conflicts fail explicitly.
ARCHITECTURE.shadow: Slice 002 records are read-only inputs to a disposable local ledger; no executor is dispatched.

LEDGER_CHANGES.storage: Existing SQLite ledger gains telemetry rows keyed by execution_id and attempt.
LEDGER_CHANGES.duplicate_semantics: Same execution/attempt and same record digest is a no-op; a different digest is TELEMETRY_CONTRADICTION.

MEASUREMENT_METHODS.bytes: MEASURED as UTF-8 length of the existing/default JSON representation or exact prompt material
MEASUREMENT_METHODS.token_proxy: ESTIMATED as ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 4); not a tokenizer and not runtime usage
MEASUREMENT_METHODS.actual_usage: MEASURED only when explicit non-negative runtime usage counters exist
MEASUREMENT_METHODS.task_accumulation: Unique dispatched LLM execution/attempt proxies only; deterministic and recovery executions contribute zero model calls
MEASUREMENT_METHODS.quota: Separate from token usage; no conversion or causal attribution

AVAILABLE_RUNTIME_USAGE_FIELDS: runtime_input_tokens when an event explicitly supplies input_tokens
runtime_output_tokens when an event explicitly supplies output_tokens
cached_tokens when an event explicitly supplies cached_input_tokens or cached_tokens
reasoning_tokens when an event explicitly supplies reasoning_output_tokens or reasoning_tokens
model identity when explicitly supplied to the observer
UNAVAILABLE_RUNTIME_USAGE_FIELDS: All actual token fields for the preserved Slice 002 records
Context-only actual tokens when runtime reports only total input
Provider hidden instructions and reasoning not exposed by runtime
Task complexity, full reconstruction, semantic reuse and material delta without deterministic existing markers

ESTIMATED_VALUES.classification: ESTIMATED proxy; not bill, actual use or attributable quota

NOT_AVAILABLE_VALUES.classification: NOT_AVAILABLE; values are null, never zero

checks: deterministic execution is not an LLM call
recovery and duplicate no-op do not double count
tokens are not converted to quota
